parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The ID of the migration job.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: partition
parameters.description: The partition value. This parameter is used to filter migration tasks by a specific partition value.

parameters.name: sourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data source.

parameters.name: srcDbName
parameters.description: The name of the source database.

parameters.name: srcTableName
parameters.description: The name of the source table.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the migration task.
